definitions: to continue to function or operate with very little energy, resources, or strength remaining
to be extremely tired or exhausted but still continuing to work or perform
examples: After working 16-hour days for a week, I was running on fumes.
The project team was running on fumes by the deadline, but they finished it.
The old car was running on fumes, barely making it to the gas station.
synonyms: to be on one's last legs
to be at the end of one's rope
